entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I have this... uh... VeloBand Cadence Sensor, and I think I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's... VF91023. I just feel so lost with it. It's not what I expected at all.
Okay, thank you. I'm pulling up your order now. Just to be sure I'm understanding correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the sensor, or more of a personal preference?

I don't think it's broken... I just... I'm so confused by it. The website made it seem so simple, and now I have it and I can't get it to do what I want. I don't understand the settings. Can't you just help me? I'd rather just send it back.
I understand completely. It can sometimes take a moment to get used to new tech. Let me just quickly review our return policy for your order. One moment.

Alright, I've checked everything here. I see the VeloBand was delivered to you 12 days ago. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery, so you are well within the window. We can absolutely get this return started for you.
Oh, really? It's that simple? I was so worried it was going to be a whole thing and I was too late.

Not at all. I'm processing the return authorization for you right now. I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. All you need to do is pack the sensor back in its original packaging, attach that label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll get a full refund.
Wow. That's... thank you. That's a huge relief. You've been very helpful, Alex.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could make it easy for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was it. Thank you so much!
Alright. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
